shellCommands.command: cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md && echo "-----" && find .agents/skills/gravity-ui -type f && echo "-----" && ls -la && cat package.json 2>/dev/null; git status --short | head -50

head -80 .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && echo "-----SRC" && find src index.html AGENTS.md .claude -type f | head -50 && echo "-----" && for f in $(find src -type f) index.html vite.config.ts tsconfig.json; do echo "== $f"; cat "$f"; echo; done

cat AGENTS.md && echo "-----" && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/ && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | grep '"version"' && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>/dev/null | head; echo "-----"; node -v; npm -v; npm view @gravity-ui/charts version 2>&1 | tail -3; npm view @gravity-ui/charts peerDependencies 2>&1 | tail -20

for v in $(npm view @gravity-ui/charts versions --json 2>/dev/null | tr -d '[],"' | grep -E '^[0-9]' | tail -40); do echo "$v: $(npm view @gravity-ui/charts@$v peerDependencies --json 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\n ' )"; done 2>/dev/null | grep -E 'uikit' | tail -40
npm view @gravity-ui/charts versions --json 2>/dev/null | head -c 2000; echo; npm view @gravity-ui/charts@7 version 2>/dev/null | tail -3; npm view @gravity-ui/charts@1 version 2>/dev/null | tail -3

for v in 1.73.0 1.60.0 1.50.0 1.40.0; do echo "== $v"; npm view @gravity-ui/charts@$v peerDependencies --json 2>/dev/null; done; echo "== latest 2.x peer"; npm view @gravity-ui/charts@2 version 2>/dev/null | tail -2; npm view @gravity-ui/charts@1 version 2>/dev/null | tail -1

npm install @gravity-ui/charts@1.73.0 2>&1 | grep -v "npm warn Unknown" | tail -15; grep -A8 '"dependencies"' package.json; grep '"version"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/package.json; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/build/docs 2>/dev/null || ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs 2>/dev/null

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs && cat INDEX.md | head -80; echo "=====GETSTART"; cat get-started.md | head -150; echo "=====THEME"; ls guides; grep -ril "theme" . | head -20
cat guides/theming.md; echo "=====COLORS"; cat guides/colors.md | head -120; echo "=====LINE"; ls guides/series-types; cat guides/series-types/line.md 2>/dev/null | head -120

cd /home/sandbox/workspace && cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md | sed -n '1,200p' | grep -n -i -A12 "theme" | head -150; echo "=====THEMING REF"; grep -n -i "useThemeType\|ThemeProvider\|scoped\|nested\|setTheme\|isDark\|useTheme" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/theming.md | head -60

sed -n '60,90p;290,320p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/theming.md; echo "=====DOCS uikit theming"; grep -n -B2 -A12 "useTheme" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/guides/theming.md 2>/dev/null | head -80; echo "=====d.ts"; grep -rn "export.*useTheme\b\|export declare function useTheme\|useThemeType\|setTheme" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/*.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/*/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; grep -rln "useThemeValue" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm --include=*.d.ts | head -5

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts && cat dist/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -20; ls dist | head -30; echo "----- Chart d.ts"; grep -rl "export declare const Chart\b\|declare function Chart\|export.*Chart:" dist --include=*.d.ts | head -5; echo "----- theme usage in js"; grep -rl "useThemeType\|getThemeType\|--g-color-" dist --include=*.js 2>/dev/null | head -10; echo "----- palette"; grep -rho "\-\-g-color-data-[a-z0-9-]*" dist --include=*.js 2>/dev/null | sort | uniq -c | head -40

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm && cat components/index.d.ts | head -30; echo "-----"; grep -rn "useThemeType\|getThemeType\|ThemeType\|theme" components/ChartInner/utils/title.js | head -5; echo "----- palette files"; grep -rln "palette" --include=*.js . | head -10; echo "----- default colors"; grep -rn "colors" core/constants/defaults/*.js 2>/dev/null | head -10; find . -name "*.js" | xargs grep -ln "DEFAULT_COLORS\|defaultColors\|--g-color-" 2>/dev/null | head -10

grep -n -i "palette\|--g-color" core/constants/index.js | head -30; echo "-----"; grep -rn "useThemeType\|isDark\|'dark'" --include=*.js . | head -10; echo "----- chart.d.ts props"; sed -n '1,60p' components/ChartInner/utils/chart.d.ts | head -40
ls core/constants/ | head -40; cat core/constants/palette.js 2>/dev/null | head -80; echo "-----"; grep -rn "getComputedStyle\|--g-color" --include=*.js . | head -15

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && ls build/ | head; f=$(grep -rl "g-color-base-brand:" build --include=*.css | head -3); echo "$f"; for x in $f; do echo "== $x"; grep -o "\-\-g-color-[a-z-]*:" $x | sort -u | grep -i "data\|chart\|line\|brand\|positive\|warning\|danger\|info\|utility\|misc\|accent" | head -80; done

ls styles/ 2>/dev/null; f=$(grep -rl "g-color-base-brand" styles 2>/dev/null | head -5); echo "$f"; for x in $f; do echo "== $x"; grep -o "\-\-g-color-[a-z0-9-]*:" $x | sort -u | wc -l; done; grep -o "\-\-g-color-[a-z0-9-]*:" styles/themes/light/*.css 2>/dev/null | sort -u | sed 's/.*--g-color-//' | tr '\n' ' ' | head -c 4000

grep -o "\-\-g-color-[a-z0-9-]*" styles/themes/light/base.scss | sort -u | tr '\n' ' '; echo; echo "-----"; grep -n "g-color-line\|g-color-base-brand\|g-color-text-brand\|g-color-base-positive\|g-color-base-danger\|g-color-base-warning\|g-color-base-info\|g-color-base-utility" styles/themes/light/base.scss styles/themes/dark/base.scss | head -40

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm && grep -rln "d3-color\|from 'color'\|rgb(" --include=*.js . | head -10; echo "----- line series color usage"; grep -rn "color" plugins/line/*.js 2>/dev/null | grep -i "lighten\|brighter\|darker\|rgb\|color(" | head -10; ls plugins | head -40; echo "----- dataset colors option"; grep -rn "colors" types/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -5

grep -rn "validateSeriesColor" --include=*.js -l . | head -3; f=$(grep -rl "export const validateSeriesColor\|function validateSeriesColor" --include=*.js . | head -1); echo "== $f"; grep -n -A14 "validateSeriesColor =" "$f" | head -30; echo "----- line renderer rgb/color parse"; grep -n "rgb\|d3\|color" core/shapes/line/renderer.js | head -20
sed -n '66,84p' core/shapes/line/renderer.js; echo "----- validateSeriesColor"; grep -n -A12 "validateSeriesColor" core/validation/helpers.js | head -30
grep -rn -A10 "export function isValidSeriesColor\|isValidSeriesColor =" --include=*.js . | head -30

grep -rn "isValidSeriesColor" --include=*.js . | head -3; f=$(grep -rl "isValidSeriesColor" --include=*.js . | grep -v "helpers.js" | head -1); echo "== $f"; grep -n -B2 -A12 "isValidSeriesColor" $f | head -40
sed -n '265,290p' core/validation/helpers.js

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui && sed -n '1,200p' charts/dist/docs/guides/axes/axis-types.md | grep -n -A14 -i "category" | head -60; echo "===== exports"; grep -n "ChartData\b" charts/dist/esm/index.d.ts charts/dist/esm/types/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -5; echo "===== Text variants"; grep -rn "variant" uikit/build/esm/components/Text/Text.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -5; grep -rn "header-1\|body-1" uikit/build/esm/components/Text/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -5; echo "===== text tokens"; grep -o "\-\-g-color-text-\(info\|positive\|danger\|warning\|utility\|misc\|brand\)[a-z-]*:" uikit/styles/styles.css | sort -u | head -20

grep -n "variant\|TextVariant" uikit/build/esm/components/Text/Text.d.ts | head -8; grep -rn "TextVariant\b" uikit/build/esm/components/Text/*.d.ts | head -3; cat charts/dist/esm/index.d.ts | head -20; echo "===== category example in docs"; grep -rn -B3 -A25 "categories" charts/dist/docs/examples.md | head -60

ls charts/dist/esm/types | head; grep -n "export.*ChartData\b\|export interface ChartData\b\|export type ChartData\b" -r charts/dist/esm/types | head -3; grep -n "xAxis\|categories" charts/dist/esm/types/*.d.ts | head -12; echo "== text Text.d.ts head"; sed -n '1,25p' uikit/build/esm/components/Text/Text.d.ts | grep -v "^\s*\*\s*$" | head -25; ls uikit/build/esm/components/Text/

grep -n "variant" uikit/build/esm/components/Text/text/text.d.ts | head -5; grep -rn "header-1" uikit/build/esm/components/Text/text/*.d.ts | head -3; grep -rln "ChartData" charts/dist/esm/types/ | head; grep -rn "export.*ChartData\b" charts/dist/esm/types/ | head -3; grep -n "xAxis\|yAxis\|legend\|title" charts/dist/esm/types/chart-ui.d.ts | head -10

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs && grep -n -A8 "^\`\`\`" guides/legend.md | head -30; echo "== axis-types category config"; grep -n "categories" guides/axes/*.md | head -8; echo "== axis-labels/other"; grep -rn "yAxis" guides/axes/index.md | head -5; grep -n -B2 -A10 "## Axis padding\|## Axis" guides/axes/index.md | head -40
sed -n '30,60p' guides/axes/axis-labels.md; echo "== line-basic/ data shape for line series with marker/ legend"; grep -rn "marker" guides/series-types/line.md | head -3
cd /home/sandbox/workspace && npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head -40; echo "TSC_EXIT=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"

npm run build 2>&1 | grep -v "npm warn" | tail -15; echo "BUILD_EXIT=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"; echo "----- ru locale in charts:"; grep -rl "'ru'\|\"ru\"\|ru:" node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm --include=*.js 2>/dev/null | head -3

cat .gitignore; echo "-----"; grep -rn "color-text-info:\|color-text-danger:\|color-text-positive:" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/themes/light/base.scss node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/themes/dark/base.scss | head -8; echo "----- git status"; git status --short

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles && grep -rn "color-text-info" --include=*.scss . | head -5; grep -n -A3 "g-root_theme_dark" styles.css | grep -i "text-info\|text-danger" | head -4; grep -n "\-\-g-color-text-info:" styles.css | head -5
cd /home/sandbox/workspace && rm -rf dist && git status --short && git diff package.json
